import json,subprocess
xs=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
regions={5:(.15,.30),6:(0,.17),8:(.26,.38),10:(.23,.33),11:(0,.57),13:(0,.23),15:(.37,.57),19:(0,.37),22:(.24,.37),34:(0,.09),41:(.09,.22),60:(.37,.64),66:(.5,.75)}
for i,(a,b) in regions.items():
 p=xs[i-1]['crop'];w,h=map(int,subprocess.check_output(['magick','identify','-format','%w %h',p],text=True).split())
 subprocess.run(['magick',p,'-crop',f'{int(w*(b-a))}x{h}+{int(w*a)}+0','+repage','-resize','800%',f'zoom/check{i}.png'],check=True)
